## Pre-review gate

See `docs/agents/pre-review-checklist.md`. Fill in every part; a reviewer checks these answers before reading the diff.

**Checks run** (command and result; name any check you couldn't run, why, and the CI job that covers it):

**Used it** (rendered screen, `yos describe` output, test log; say what you looked at):

**Second look** (what a hostile re-read of the diff found, and what you changed):
